metadata.page_title: Two Buck Luck vs Sigma Chi Whiteout matchup report

summary.decision_summary: Two Buck Luck won by 10.8. Two Buck Luck left 21.4 lineup points on the table, while Sigma Chi Whiteout left 30.2.
summary.historical_summary: Two Buck Luck is 21-21 against Sigma Chi Whiteout across 42 meetings between these managers.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Two Buck Luck
summary.winner_reason: Two Buck Luck won by 10.8 after scoring +2.5 against projection. The leading starters were Kyren Williams (35.7) and Javonte Williams (32.3).
summary.loser_reason: Sigma Chi Whiteout lost by 10.8 while finishing 14.5 below projection. Kenyon Sadiq scored 0.0. Its best legal lineup added 30.2, enough to put the lineup decisions directly in the result.

summary.loser_reason: Squat could not match the opponent's RB production, losing that position battle by 18.6 points. Saquon Barkley scored 1.0. A best legal lineup added 42.1, still short of the 44.7-point margin.
